messages.subject: Re: Is there a good IDE for Rhadoop debuging?
parts:
There is no IDE for RHadoop as much as there isn't for any other R package. RHadoop is not a language so it has no IDE. For debugging, see the https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/wiki/Debugging-rmr-programs for rmr and for all packages use the regular debugging features in R (debug, recover and trace). For RStudio, I am not sure what it means that it doesn't work -- I have a slightly different opinion about that as I use it every day. They have a wonderful support staff reachable at support.rstudio.org. But you have to give them more to work on, "it doesn't work" isn't really actionable.


Antonio
